constellations.summary: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets dealing high EM-scaling Lunar-Bloom damage.
The Base DMG for Lunar-Bloom reactions caused by Nefer's Phantasm Performance is increased by 60% of her Elemental Mastery.
Extends Veil of Falsehood duration by 5s, increases stack limit to 5, and causes Phantasm Performance to deal up to 140% DMG with +200 EM.
Increases the Level of Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights by 3.
Gains Verdant Dew 25% faster in Shadow Dance state and decreases nearby opponents' Dendro RES by 20%.
Increases the Level of Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm by 3.
Phantasm Performance converts second stage into 85% EM AoE Dendro DMG and 120% EM extra instance with +15% Lunar-Bloom DMG.
